task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: The robot CAR needs to place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on the MEDICAL_TABLE. However, there is an obstacle (FRONT_CRATE) in front of CAR between it and the MEDICINE_BOTTLE. The plan is: 1) Navigate to the FRONT_CRATE, 2) Pick up the FRONT_CRATE, 3) Navigate to TEMP_ZONE and place the FRONT_CRATE there, 4) Navigate to the MEDICINE_BOTTLE, 5) Pick up the MEDICINE_BOTTLE, 6) Navigate to the MEDICAL_TABLE, 7) Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on the MEDICAL_TABLE.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of CAR that needs to be removed
TEMP_ZONE is an appropriate temporary location to place the removed obstacle
The robot can pick up the FRONT_CRATE (it is graspable)
After removing the FRONT_CRATE, the path to MEDICINE_BOTTLE is clear
